suite: Suite PR #566 (Rod Pump Design Studio Full precision switch, stacked on #554)

beginner.why: The Unit and Loads panels round the stroke and the rated displacement to 1 decimal against tolerances of 2.5e-5 and 7.3e-5.

unit_stroke_in.display_ref: src/components/rodpump/UnitPanel.jsx This linkage gives a X in stroke
unit_stroke_in.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rodpumpHeatxFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

pump_rated_displacement_bpd.evidence: With Full precision on, prints at 6 decimals (jest: rodpumpHeatxFullPrecision.test.jsx, the engine result through formatFull).

beginner.append: Read the figures in the Rod Pump Design Studio with its Full precision switch on (at the top of the page): it prints them to the precision this capstone grades, with no digit grouping.
